name: SubsurfaceMaterial
definition: A material with a defined surface that supports both BSSRDF (for subsurface scattering) and BSDF (for surface reflection/transmission) models, suitable for effects like perfect specular transmission or glossy specular transmission.
summary: SubsurfaceMaterial is a physically based model combining surface BSDF with subsurface BSSRDF, distinguished by requiring explicit absorption and scattering coefficients.
